searchText: My thinking was they had a spec (which was EIP6968's issue) and there was no spam issues created. But no objections to renumbering. We shouldn't use 7500 or 7501 for any other EIP/ERCs (unless/until we start issuing unused early numbers). Still smells like a bot opened the PR <@689161464829050960> spam issues to delete: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/7507 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/7503 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/7491 We shouldn't delete https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/7498 as it is a supposed discussion on marking issues as SPAM.
